"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"During past crises, banks, energy companies, and the real estate industry have been bailed out.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Poor, working-class, and already marginalized people have suffered the most during past crises.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"With the COVID-19 outbreak and a looming economic recession, hospital workers, poor and unhoused people, the elderly, incarcerated people, the immunocompromised, immigrants, and other marginalized groups will likely bear the most impact.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Millions of people have inadequate health insurance or no health insurance at all.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Millions of people are living paycheck to paycheck.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Millions of people are not given paid time off from work.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Workers and poor people will be vulnerable to illness while being unable to afford treatment or even testing, endangering whole communities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Many who miss work because of the outbreak will lose pay.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Many who miss work because of the outbreak will lose their health insurance.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Many who miss work because of the outbreak will be unable to pay utility bills.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Many who miss work because of the outbreak will face eviction.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
